# equinix_fabric_ip_block (Resource)

Fabric V4 API compatible resource allows creation and management of Equinix Fabric IP Blocks.

Additional Documentation:
* API: https://docs.equinix.com/api-catalog/fabricv4/#tag/IP-Blocks



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project` (Attributes) Project this IP block belongs to (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--project))
- `type` (String) IP block type; IPV4_IP_BLOCK or IPV6_IP_BLOCK

### Optional

- `account` (Attributes) Billing account for the IP block (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--account))
- `location` (Attributes) Metro location for the IP block (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--location))
- `prefix` (String) CIDR prefix (e.g. 192.0.2.0/28)
- `prefix_length` (Number) CIDR prefix length (e.g. 28 for a /28 block)
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `assets` (Attributes List) Resources currently using this IP block (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--assets))
- `change` (Attributes) Current pending change on this IP block (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--change))
- `change_log` (Attributes) Timestamps tracking resource lifecycle (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--change_log))
- `href` (String) URL of the IP block resource
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the resource
- `order` (Attributes) Order details for this IP block (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--order))
- `ownership` (String) Ownership type; EQUINIX or CUSTOMER
- `state` (String) Provisioning state of the IP block (PENDING, ACTIVE, DELETING, DELETED, FAILED)
- `uuid` (String) Equinix-assigned UUID of the IP block

### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Read operations occur during any refresh or planning operation when refresh is enabled.
